meta.name: planning
meta.description: Systematic project planning and task decomposition. Use when starting a new feature, refactoring, debugging, or any multi-step task. Provides structured thinking frameworks, spec-first analysis, and staged implementation plans.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂任务拆成可执行的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对多步骤任务常不知从何下手
copy.tagline_en: Break complex tasks into actionable steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face multi-step tasks and need a structured plan

howto.what: Claude 会在动手写代码前先出一份计划：先复述需求、列出假设，再分析涉及的文件，给出分阶段实施步骤和风险，最后等你确认才执行。
howto.when: 当你索要计划/方案、任务涉及3个以上文件或100行以上改动、需求模糊时触发。

say.text: 先给我一个计划，我要加一个用户登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会先出计划，不会直接写代码。

say.text: 这个重构涉及5个文件，帮我分步规划。
say.note: 会触发影响分析和分阶段计划。

howto.what_en: Claude will produce a plan before writing code: restate requirements, list assumptions, analyze affected files, give staged steps and risks, then wait for your confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task is non-trivial: you ask for a plan/approach, changes touch 3+ files or 100+ lines, or requirements are ambiguous.

say_en.text: Give me a plan for adding a login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will plan first, not code.

say_en.text: This refactor touches 5 files; plan it in steps.
say_en.note: Triggers impact analysis and staged plan.
